digest.component_or_area: code-review verdict assembly and sidecar wiring
propositions: code-review verdicts assembled by code_review_coach and finalized by finalize_code_review_verdict never set the provider_provenance key, unlike plan-review and completion gates which were fixed in story 343b
the sidecar reads verdict.get('provider_provenance') at sidecar.py:106 but receives None because the verdict assembly path never wires the provenance record from the verify step output
the provider_provenance record must be threaded from the Pass-2 verify agent step (where the runner stamped it) through to the terminal verdict, without recomputation
the degraded/outage code-review verdict path must omit provider_provenance rather than synthesizing one from config
test coverage must use the real YAML, real ops, and real verdict assembly path to detect breaks in the wiring chain, not hand-constructed verdicts
